name: SplatView MR for TRIPO 3D glb files
summary: SplatView MR places your own 3D models, images, and video into your real room through passthrough on Meta Quest. Load files straight from the Download folder, point-and-grab to move them, scale from 0.0001× to 10,000×, and fly through anything too big for your space. Save named scenes. Share over Wi-Fi — the host owns the scene, guests get view-only access, and missing files stream across automatically. Native MP4, no conversion. Free, no account, no tracking. Built in Godot 4 by Sparklen Apps.
